automated_evidence.rule: Store only short candidate values and page pointers; do not commit full text excerpts.

supplement_extraction.rule: Supplement text extraction writes only ignored local text artifacts; tracked audit files store counts, statuses, and short evidence pointers.

manual_reviews.rule: Manual reviews promote auto-mined candidates only after repeated critical passes; store normalized values, an orientation ledger, field statuses, confidence scores, and short source pointers, not full text.

pdf_retrieval_inventory.rule: One row per literature record; records whether the main publication PDF has been retrieved locally, gives the DOI/DOI URL for missing PDFs, and names the target local PDF path.

protocol_lineage_candidates.rule: Cited prior-protocol papers that may contain missing stimulus, trajectory, timing, apparatus, or count details for another audited paper; promote to the main literature database after screening when appropriate.

visualization_types.label: RT by SOA/distance curve
visualization_types.description: Line, scatter, or point plot of tactile RT or facilitation across SOA, temporal delay, distance, or distance-at-touch.

visualization_types.label: Sigmoid or psychometric fit
visualization_types.description: Sigmoid, logistic, psychometric, cumulative-Gaussian, or similar fitted function used to estimate PPS shape or boundary.

visualization_types.label: PPS boundary or size index
visualization_types.description: Single reported boundary, threshold, midpoint, index, area, width, or size estimate for PPS.

visualization_types.label: Condition/group bar or box summary
visualization_types.description: Bar, box, violin, dot, or summary plot comparing PPS measures across conditions, groups, blocks, tools, posture, or phases.

visualization_types.label: Spatial map, heatmap, or body boundary
visualization_types.description: Body-centered map, top-view boundary, heatmap, contour, spatial field, peri-hand/trunk/head map, or two-dimensional PPS representation.

visualization_types.label: Near/far or distance-bin plot
visualization_types.description: Discrete near/far, proximal/distal, D1-Dn, or distance-bin visualization rather than a continuous fitted curve.

visualization_types.label: Apparatus or trajectory schematic
visualization_types.description: Figure, diagram, photograph, or schematic showing participant, tactile site, speakers, virtual source path, or looming/receding trajectory.

visualization_types.label: Neural trace, topography, or brain map
visualization_types.description: ERP, EEG, intracranial, TMS/MEP, fMRI, source-localization, scalp-topography, or brain-map visualization tied to PPS effects.

visualization_types.label: Model parameter or fit table
visualization_types.description: Table or panel reporting fitted parameters, model comparison, slopes, boundaries, coefficients, or fit statistics.

pps_visualization_inventory.rule: One row per automated visualization-form candidate. Use it as a triage ledger for manual figure/caption review; every candidate requires visual verification of plotted parameters before confirmation. Do not commit figure screenshots or long source text.

segment_1_stimulus_reconstruction.label: Stimulus type

segment_1_stimulus_reconstruction.label: Source/provenance

segment_1_stimulus_reconstruction.label: Number of trajectories/tones
segment_1_stimulus_reconstruction.description: Distinct looming/receding/static paths, tones, or auditory conditions.

segment_1_stimulus_reconstruction.label: Trajectory path
segment_1_stimulus_reconstruction.description: Start/end distance, movement direction, participant-facing direction, speaker/source position, body anchor, azimuth/elevation, and spatial coordinate frame.

segment_1_stimulus_reconstruction.label: Duration
segment_1_stimulus_reconstruction.description: Auditory stimulus duration and any pre/post padding.

segment_1_stimulus_reconstruction.label: Speed/path length
segment_1_stimulus_reconstruction.description: Motion speed, path length, propagation timing, or distance-at-time mapping.

segment_1_stimulus_reconstruction.label: Auditory conditions
segment_1_stimulus_reconstruction.description: Valence, direction, semantic, movement, or apparatus conditions affecting the auditory stimulus.

segment_1_stimulus_reconstruction.label: Gain/envelope
segment_1_stimulus_reconstruction.description: SPL, intensity law, gain curve, cross-fade, or amplitude-field information.

segment_1_stimulus_reconstruction.label: Renderer/HRTF/speaker apparatus
segment_1_stimulus_reconstruction.description: Headphones, HRTF, Unity/3D Tune-In, physical speakers, arrays, room/speaker layout, or other rendering provenance.

segment_2_sequence_and_intermixing.label: Trial rows/families
segment_2_sequence_and_intermixing.description: Within-trial audio sequence families and task rows.

segment_2_sequence_and_intermixing.label: Condition intermixing
segment_2_sequence_and_intermixing.description: Whether systematic manipulations are intermixed with task trials or separated.

segment_2_sequence_and_intermixing.label: Blocked/random order
segment_2_sequence_and_intermixing.description: Blocked condition structure, random intermixing, and task-critical order constraints.

segment_2_sequence_and_intermixing.label: ITI/jitter policy
segment_2_sequence_and_intermixing.description: Fixed ITI, jitter values, jitter range, distribution, or hazard-control policy.

segment_2_sequence_and_intermixing.label: Response window
segment_2_sequence_and_intermixing.description: Allowed response interval, timeout, or scoring window.

segment_2_sequence_and_intermixing.label: Task-critical sequence rules
segment_2_sequence_and_intermixing.description: Special trial scheduling, target/no-target logic, or expectancy controls.

segment_3_tactile_soa_baseline.label: Tactile stimulus
segment_3_tactile_soa_baseline.description: Tactile modality, body site, waveform, duration, frequency, amplitude, and calibration.

segment_3_tactile_soa_baseline.label: SOA/distance-at-touch table
segment_3_tactile_soa_baseline.description: SOA values, tactile timing values, or distance-at-tactile values.

segment_3_tactile_soa_baseline.label: Baseline strategy
segment_3_tactile_soa_baseline.description: Tactile-only, far/static, fastest-baseline, SOA-matched, direction-coupled, or other baseline type.

segment_3_tactile_soa_baseline.label: Baseline SOAs/timing
segment_3_tactile_soa_baseline.description: Baseline SOA values, baseline timing relative to omitted sound, or fixed baseline schedule.

segment_3_tactile_soa_baseline.description: Auditory-only, tactile-only, omitted target, no-go, target-absent, or other catch rule.

segment_4_counts.description: Trial repetitions for each tactile SOA crossed with relevant conditions.

segment_4_counts.description: Number of blocks, sessions, or phases when task-relevant.

segment_4_counts.label: Total trial count
segment_4_counts.description: Total trials per participant, block, condition, or experiment.

review_rule.missing_value_rule: Only mark not_reported_after_review after main PDF extraction, targeted methods/table search, supplement search, fallback extractor/source check, and cited prior-protocol lineage search have all been attempted.
review_rule.orientation_frame_rule: Before accepting a trajectory/direction value, record participant-facing direction, speaker/source room coordinates, body-relative mapping, tactile anchor, movement implementation, and evidence class; figure-left/right is not participant-left/right unless orientation is explicit.
review_rule.visual_approximation_rule: For every visual/spatial clue, record the raw page or figure clue, participant-facing vector, speaker/source vector, face-to-source relation, body-relative translation, and approximation grade; unscaled schematic evidence stays qualitative.
review_rule.pps_visualization_rule: For every reviewed study, record how PPS itself is visualized or summarized: axes, metric, model form, boundary/index definition, condition facets, uncertainty display, figure/table pointer, and visual verification status for plotted parameters.
review_rule.plotted_parameter_visual_verification_ru: Render or visually inspect each cited plot/table page and verify plotted SOA/distance/bin values, axis units, y-axis metric, model parameters, PPS boundary/index values, and uncertainty encodings against captions, methods, results text, or tables before marking a visualization form confirmed.
review_rule.copyright_boundary: Do not commit PDFs, supplements, extracted full text, screenshots of pages, or long verbatim passages.
review_rule.automated_evidence_rule: Automated evidence mining stores only short candidate values and page pointers; it is not a substitute for final human/AI critical review against PDFs and supplements.
